Sum of Generic Numbers

Problem Statement:
Write a program to compute the sum of elements in a generic list. The program should accept numeric values of Integer, Double, or Float type using wrapper classes and generics.

Description:

Create a generic class GenericSum<T extends Number>.

Implement a method sum(List<T> list) to compute the sum of elements.

Ensure type safety by restricting generics to numeric wrapper classes.

Input Format:

First line: number of elements n

Second line: n space-separated numbers

Output Format:

Sum of all elements
